title: Nine die in ‘cataclysmic’ Florida business jet crash
paragraphs: Nine people have died after a business jet crashed into a residential neighbourhood in South Florida, the United States.
All on board were killed in the crash, which US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy described as a “horrific tragedy” in a post on X on Sunday.
Federal Aviation Administration staff were on their way to the crash site to support a National Transportation Safety Board investigation into the incident, Duffy said.
